newsitem.title: TANZANIA: Tanzania shilling stable on dollar, pound.
newsitem.headline: Tanzania shilling stable on dollar, pound.

text.p: The Tanzanian shilling took news of the resignation of the country's finance minister in its stride on Monday, remaining stable against the dollar but depreciating against the pound, the central bank said.
The local shilling exchanged at a commercial mean rate of 597.9600 to the dollar, the same rate as Friday's close.
Against the pound, the shilling exchanged at a mean rate of 978.2946 compared to Friday's 974.8856.
"Our market is very, very shallow. These political things do not effect our rate like those in strong economies," one dealer told Reuters.
